---
title: "Flag Viewer"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| cache: true
files <- list.files("flags", pattern = "\\.png$", full.names = TRUE)
flag_codes <- sub("\\.png$", "", basename(files))

# Summarize each flag as a 6x9 grid of average RGB colors
vecs <- parallel::mclapply(files, \(f) {
  img <- png::readPNG(f)
  d <- dim(img)
  if (length(d) == 2) img <- array(img, dim = c(d[1], d[2], 3))
  r_idx <- round(seq(1, d[1], length.out = 60))
  c_idx <- round(seq(1, d[2], length.out = 90))
  sub_img <- img[r_idx, c_idx, 1:3]
  thumb <- array(0, dim = c(6, 9, 3))
  for (i in 1:6) {
    for (j in 1:9) {
      thumb[i, j, ] <- colMeans(
        sub_img[(i * 10 - 9):(i * 10), (j * 10 - 9):(j * 10), , drop = FALSE],
        dims = 2
      )
    }
  }
  as.numeric(thumb)
}, mc.cores = parallel::detectCores())

# Compute Euclidean distance between all pairs of flags
mat <- do.call(rbind, vecs)
rownames(mat) <- flag_codes
dmat <- as.matrix(dist(mat))

# Store the 3 closest and 3 farthest matches for each flag
matches <- setNames(lapply(flag_codes, \(code) {
  others <- sort(dmat[code, flag_codes != code])
  list(
    similar = names(others)[1:3],
    different = names(rev(others))[1:3]
  )
}), flag_codes)
```

```{r}
ojs_define(codes = flag_codes, matches = matches)
```

```{ojs}
viewof selected = Inputs.select(codes, {
  label: "Select a flag:",
  value: "us"
})

// Helper to render a flag card with its 2-letter code
renderFlag = (code, width = "180px") => htl.html`
  <div style="text-align: center;">
    <img src="flags/${code}.png" style="width: ${width}; border: 1px solid #ccc; display: block;">
    <div style="margin-top: 0.25rem; font-weight: bold;">${code}</div>
  </div>
`

htl.html`
  <div style="margin-top: 1rem;">
    <h3>Selected Flag</h3>
    ${renderFlag(selected, "300px")}

    <h3 style="margin-top: 1.5rem;">3 Most Similar Flags</h3>
    <div style="display: flex; gap: 1rem; flex-wrap: wrap;">
      ${matches[selected].similar.map(c => renderFlag(c))}
    </div>

    <h3 style="margin-top: 1.5rem;">3 Most Different Flags</h3>
    <div style="display: flex; gap: 1rem; flex-wrap: wrap;">
      ${matches[selected].different.map(c => renderFlag(c))}
    </div>
  </div>
`
```
